subject: Application for CAD Draftsperson (Student), Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying for the CAD Draftsperson (Student) role listed on the AR Civil Consultancy website. The role is open to people who have recently completed an Advanced Diploma in Civil Construction Design, which is the qualification I have just finished.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work.

Your work on road widening and drainage design for local infrastructure upgrades is the kind of drafting I would like to learn on. My AutoCAD, Civil 3D and Revit experience comes from study rather than a paid drafting job, so I would value the mentoring the role offers.

Would you be open to a short call or a meeting at your St Kilda Road office? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

Hello,

I am applying for the Graduate Engineer (under one year of experience) position in traffic and transport engineering listed on the onemilegrid careers page, which asks for applications to this address.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design, with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD. From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge. I am Melton based, hold a White Card, a driver's licence and my own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines.

The chance to prepare transport impact assessments and give design advice while reporting directly to a Director is what draws me to onemilegrid. My road work so far is geometry, Austroads guides and AS 1742.14 from my course; I have not yet used SIDRA or traffic modelling software, so that is where I would be learning.

Could we arrange a short conversation about the graduate role? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
